repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(all(#AirQualitySensor).airQualitySensor_fineDustLevel <= 80)
triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#AirQualitySensor).airQualitySensor_fineDustLevel > 80)
all(#AirPurifier).airPurifier_setAirPurifierMode("high")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` guard instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the body to execute exactly when the condition transitions from false to true. The candidate only checks the condition at the start of every 1-second iteration, missing the event if it occurs between iterations.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard two-wait rearming pattern: check `fired` state, block until condition is false (rearm), block until condition is true (trigger), execute body, and mark `fired`. This ensures the action fires on the exact rising edge regardless of the wrapper period.
